verses.he: בְּ֭רִית כָּרַ֣תִּי לְעֵינָ֑י וּמָ֥ה אֶ֝תְבּוֹנֵ֗ן עַל־בְּתוּלָֽה׃
verses.en: I made a covenant with mine eyes; How then should I look upon a maid?

verses.he: וּמֶ֤ה׀ חֵ֣לֶק אֱל֣וֹהַּ מִמָּ֑עַל וְֽנַחֲלַ֥ת שַׁ֝דַּ֗י מִמְּרֹמִֽים׃
verses.en: For what would be the portion of God from above, And the heritage of the Almighty from on high?

verses.he: הֲלֹא־אֵ֥יד לְעַוָּ֑ל וְ֝נֵ֗כֶר לְפֹ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.en: Is it not calamity to the unrighteous, And disaster to the workers of iniquity?

verses.he: הֲלֹא־ה֖וּא יִרְאֶ֣ה דְרָכָ֑י וְֽכָל־צְעָדַ֥י יִסְפּֽוֹר׃
verses.en: Doth not He see my ways, And count all my steps?

verses.he: אִם־הָלַ֥כְתִּי עִם־שָׁ֑וְא וַתַּ֖חַשׁ עַל־מִרְמָ֣ה רַגְלִֽי׃
verses.en: If I have walked with vanity, And my foot hath hasted to deceit—

verses.he: יִשְׁקְלֵ֥נִי בְמֹאזְנֵי־צֶ֑דֶק וְיֵדַ֥ע אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ תֻּמָּתִֽי׃
verses.en: Let me be weighed in a just balance, That God may know mine integrity—

verses.he: אִ֥ם תִּטֶּ֣ה אַשֻּׁרִי֮ מִנִּ֪י הַ֫דָּ֥רֶךְ וְאַחַ֣ר עֵ֭ינַי הָלַ֣ךְ לִבִּ֑י וּ֝בְכַפַּ֗י דָּ֣בַק מֻאֽוּם׃
verses.en: If my step hath turned out of the way, And my heart walked after mine eyes, And if any spot hath cleaved to my hands;

verses.he: אֶ֭זְרְעָה וְאַחֵ֣ר יֹאכֵ֑ל וְֽצֶאֱצָאַ֥י יְשֹׁרָֽשׁוּ׃
verses.en: Then let me sow, and let another eat; Yea, let the produce of my field be rooted out.

verses.he: אִם־נִפְתָּ֣ה לִ֭בִּי עַל־אִשָּׁ֑ה וְעַל־פֶּ֖תַח רֵעִ֣י אָרָֽבְתִּי׃
verses.en: If my heart have been enticed unto a woman, And I have lain in wait at my neighbour’s door;

verses.he: תִּטְחַ֣ן לְאַחֵ֣ר אִשְׁתִּ֑י וְ֝עָלֶ֗יהָ יִכְרְע֥וּן אֲחֵרִֽין׃
verses.en: Then let my wife grind unto another, And let others bow down upon her. .

verses.he: כִּי־הוא [הִ֥יא] זִמָּ֑ה והיא [וְ֝ה֗וּא] עָו‍ֹ֥ן פְּלִילִֽים׃
verses.en: For that were a heinous crime; Yea, it were an iniquity to be punished by the judges.

verses.he: כִּ֤י אֵ֣שׁ הִ֭יא עַד־אֲבַדּ֣וֹן תֹּאכֵ֑ל וּֽבְכָל־תְּב֖וּאָתִ֣י תְשָׁרֵֽשׁ׃
verses.en: For it is a fire that consumeth unto destruction, And would root out all mine increase.

verses.he: אִם־אֶמְאַ֗ס מִשְׁפַּ֣ט עַ֭בְדִּי וַאֲמָתִ֑י בְּ֝רִבָ֗ם עִמָּדִֽי׃
verses.en: If I did despise the cause of my man-servant, Or of my maid-servant, when they contended with me—

verses.he: וּמָ֣ה אֶֽ֭עֱשֶׂה כִּֽי־יָק֣וּם אֵ֑ל וְכִֽי־יִ֝פְקֹ֗ד מָ֣ה אֲשִׁיבֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: What then shall I do when God riseth up? And when He remembereth, what shall I answer Him?

verses.he: הֲ‍ֽ֝לֹא־בַ֭בֶּטֶן עֹשֵׂ֣נִי עָשָׂ֑הוּ וַ֝יְכֻנֶ֗נּוּ בָּרֶ֥חֶם אֶחָֽד׃
verses.en: Did not He that made me in the womb make him? And did not One fashion us in the womb?

verses.he: אִם־אֶ֭מְנַע מֵחֵ֣פֶץ דַּלִּ֑ים וְעֵינֵ֖י אַלְמָנָ֣ה אֲכַלֶּֽה׃
verses.en: If I have withheld aught that the poor desired, Or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail;

verses.he: וְאֹכַ֣ל פִּתִּ֣י לְבַדִּ֑י וְלֹא־אָכַ֖ל יָת֣וֹם מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
verses.en: Or have eaten my morsel myself alone, And the fatherless hath not eaten thereof—

verses.he: כִּ֣י מִ֭נְּעוּרַי גְּדֵלַ֣נִי כְאָ֑ב וּמִבֶּ֖טֶן אִמִּ֣י אַנְחֶֽנָּה׃
verses.en: Nay, from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, And I have been her guide from my mother’s womb.

verses.he: אִם־אֶרְאֶ֣ה א֭וֹבֵד מִבְּלִ֣י לְב֑וּשׁ וְאֵ֥ין כְּ֝ס֗וּת לָאֶבְיֽוֹן׃
verses.en: If I have seen any wanderer in want of clothing, Or that the needy had no covering;

verses.he: אִם־לֹ֣א בֵרֲכ֣וּנִי חלצו [חֲלָצָ֑יו] וּמִגֵּ֥ז כְּ֝בָשַׂי יִתְחַמָּֽם׃
verses.en: If his loins have not blessed me, And if he were not warmed with the fleece of my sheep;

verses.he: אִם־הֲנִיפ֣וֹתִי עַל־יָת֣וֹם יָדִ֑י כִּֽי־אֶרְאֶ֥ה בַ֝שַּׁ֗עַר עֶזְרָתִֽי׃
verses.en: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, Because I saw my help in the gate;

verses.he: כְּ֭תֵפִי מִשִּׁכְמָ֣ה תִפּ֑וֹל וְ֝אֶזְרֹעִ֗י מִקָּנָ֥ה תִשָּׁבֵֽר׃
verses.en: Then let my shoulder fall from the shoulder-blade, And mine arm be broken from the bone.

verses.he: כִּ֤י פַ֣חַד אֵ֭לַי אֵ֣יד אֵ֑ל וּ֝מִשְּׂאֵת֗וֹ לֹ֣א אוּכָֽל׃
verses.en: For calamity from God was a terror to me, And by reason of His majesty I could do nothing.

verses.he: אִם־שַׂ֣מְתִּי זָהָ֣ב כִּסְלִ֑י וְ֝לַכֶּ֗תֶם אָמַ֥רְתִּי מִבְטַחִֽי׃
verses.en: If I have made gold my hope, And have said to the fine gold: ‘Thou art my confidence’;

verses.he: אִם־אֶ֭שְׂמַח כִּי־רַ֣ב חֵילִ֑י וְכִֽי־כַ֝בִּ֗יר מָצְאָ֥ה יָדִֽי׃
verses.en: If I rejoiced because my wealth was great, And because my hand had gotten much;

verses.he: אִם־אֶרְאֶ֣ה א֖וֹר כִּ֣י יָהֵ֑ל וְ֝יָרֵ֗חַ יָקָ֥ר הֹלֵֽךְ׃
verses.en: If I beheld the sun when it shined, Or the moon walking in brightness;

verses.he: וַיִּ֣פְתְּ בַּסֵּ֣תֶר לִבִּ֑י וַתִּשַּׁ֖ק יָדִ֣י לְפִֽי׃
verses.en: And my heart hath been secretly enticed, And my mouth hath kissed my hand;

verses.he: גַּם־ה֖וּא עָו‍ֹ֣ן פְּלִילִ֑י כִּֽי־כִחַ֖שְׁתִּי לָאֵ֣ל מִמָּֽעַל׃
verses.en: This also were an iniquity to be punished by the judges; For I should have lied to God that is above.

verses.he: אִם־אֶ֭שְׂמַח בְּפִ֣יד מְשַׂנְאִ֑י וְ֝הִתְעֹרַ֗רְתִּי כִּֽי־מְצָ֥אוֹ רָֽע׃
verses.en: If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me, Or exulted when evil found him—

verses.he: וְלֹא־נָתַ֣תִּי לַחֲטֹ֣א חִכִּ֑י לִשְׁאֹ֖ל בְּאָלָ֣ה נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.en: Yea, I suffered not my mouth to sin By asking his life with a curse.

verses.he: אִם־לֹ֣א אָ֭מְרוּ מְתֵ֣י אָהֳלִ֑י מִֽי־יִתֵּ֥ן מִ֝בְּשָׂר֗וֹ לֹ֣א נִשְׂבָּֽע׃
verses.en: If the men of my tent said not: ‘Who can find one that hath not been satisfied with his meat?’ .

verses.he: בַּ֭חוּץ לֹא־יָלִ֣ין גֵּ֑ר דְּ֝לָתַ֗י לָאֹ֥רַח אֶפְתָּֽח׃
verses.en: The stranger did not lodge in the street; My doors I opened to the roadside.

verses.he: אִם־כִּסִּ֣יתִי כְאָדָ֣ם פְּשָׁעָ֑י לִטְמ֖וֹן בְּחֻבִּ֣י עֲו‍ֹֽנִי׃
verses.en: If after the manner of men I covered my transgressions, By hiding mine iniquity in my bosom—

verses.he: כִּ֤י אֶֽעֱר֨וֹץ׀ הָ֘מ֤וֹן רַבָּ֗ה וּבוּז־מִשְׁפָּח֥וֹת יְחִתֵּ֑נִי וָ֝אֶדֹּ֗ם לֹא־אֵ֥צֵא פָֽתַח׃
verses.en: Because I feared the great multitude, And the most contemptible among families terrified me, So that I kept silence, and went not out of the door.

verses.he: מִ֤י יִתֶּן־לִ֨י׀ שֹׁ֘מֵ֤עַֽ לִ֗י הֶן־תָּ֭וִי שַׁדַּ֣י יַעֲנֵ֑נִי וְסֵ֥פֶר כָּ֝תַ֗ב אִ֣ישׁ רִיבִֽי׃
verses.en: Oh that I had one to hear me!— Lo, here is my signature, let the Almighty answer me— And that I had the indictment which mine adversary hath written!

verses.he: אִם־לֹ֣א עַל־שִׁ֭כְמִי אֶשָּׂאֶ֑נּוּ אֶֽעֶנְדֶ֖נּוּ עֲטָר֣וֹת לִֽי׃
verses.en: Surely I would carry it upon my shoulder; I would bind it unto me as a crown.

verses.he: מִסְפַּ֣ר צְ֭עָדַי אַגִּידֶ֑נּוּ כְּמוֹ־נָ֝גִ֗יד אֲקָרֲבֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: I would declare unto him the number of my steps; As a prince would I go near unto him.

verses.he: אִם־עָ֭לַי אַדְמָתִ֣י תִזְעָ֑ק וְ֝יַ֗חַד תְּלָמֶ֥יהָ יִבְכָּיֽוּן׃
verses.en: If my land cry out against me, And the furrows thereof weep together;

verses.he: אִם־כֹּ֭חָהּ אָכַ֣לְתִּי בְלִי־כָ֑סֶף וְנֶ֖פֶשׁ בְּעָלֶ֣יהָ הִפָּֽחְתִּי׃
verses.en: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, Or have caused the tillers thereof to be disappointed—

verses.he: תַּ֤חַת חִטָּ֨ה׀ יֵ֥צֵא ח֗וֹחַ וְתַֽחַת־שְׂעֹרָ֥ה בָאְשָׁ֑ה תַּ֝֗מּוּ דִּבְרֵ֥י אִיּֽוֹב׃
verses.en: Let thistles grow instead of wheat, And noisome weeds instead of barley. The words of Job are ended.
